mailbox from many addresses is limited without locking the mailbox itself.

AbsenceCancel.title: AbsenceCancel
AbsenceCancel.description:
Cancel an absence without deleting it. A reason is mandatory.

Cancellation is deliberately a different operation from correction: the
date was wrong (correction) is not the same claim as the absence should not
exist at all (cancellation).

AbsenceCorrect.description: Supersede an existing absence. A reason is mandatory.

AbsenceCreate.description:
Record an absence against one admission episode.

The episode is named explicitly: a student may have more than one episode,
and an absence belongs to exactly one of them.

A controlled correction; both dates and a substantial reason.

Fields are optional here so the service can answer with a stable error
code rather than Pydantic's field-array response. The service enforces all
three requirements before any write.

Unknown fields are rejected. A caller that sends ``role_names`` instead of
``roles`` used to have the field silently ignored, which turns a privilege
request into a confusing success; the request must fail instead.

``reason`` is validated by the router only when the role set actually
changes, so a caller without permission still receives 403 rather than a
request-validation error that leaks the endpoint contract.

ChangeRequestReview.description: Schema for management reviewing a change request.

change_type.title: Change Type
change_type.description: Type of change: PASSPORT, VISA, RESIDENCE_PERMIT

ClassSectionUpdate.title: ClassSectionUpdate
ClassSectionUpdate.description:
Editable attributes of an offering.

The course, period and section code are included because correcting a
mis-scheduled section is an ordinary office task; the service layer guards
the cases where changing them would strand a roster or a schedule.

CommencementApprove.title: CommencementApprove
CommencementApprove.description:
Approve a commencement for one admission episode.

``confirmed_suggested_date`` is the explicit confirmation: the approver must
echo the suggestion they reviewed. If the suggestion has changed in the
meantime (an intake date correction, for example), the request is refused
rather than silently accepting a stale screen.

CommencementCorrect.title: CommencementCorrect
CommencementCorrect.description: Supersede the current commencement with a corrected one.

CommencementSummary.title: CommencementSummary
CommencementSummary.description: One episode: the suggestion, the current record and the whole history.

CountItem.title: CountItem
CountItem.description: A generic labelled count used by breakdown tables.

CountryStudentCount.title: CountryStudentCount
CountryStudentCount.description: Aggregated count for one ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country.

DocumentExpectationRequest.title: DocumentExpectationRequest
DocumentExpectationRequest.description: Set the institutional expectation flags on a document.

DocumentResponse.title: DocumentResponse
DocumentResponse.description:
Document metadata.

Deliberately excludes ``object_key`` and every storage internal: clients
address documents by id through the authorization-checked endpoints only.

DocumentReviewRequest.title: DocumentReviewRequest
DocumentReviewRequest.description: Approve or reject an uploaded document.

DocumentReviewStatus.title: DocumentReviewStatus
DocumentReviewStatus.description:
Institutional review state of an uploaded document.

A document exists as soon as it is uploaded, but "has the office accepted
this document?" is a separate question. Keeping review state distinct from
storage lifecycle (``DocumentStatus``) means archiving a document never
silently erases whether it was approved.

DocumentScanStatus.title: DocumentScanStatus
DocumentScanStatus.description:
Malware-scan state for a document's stored bytes.

``LEGACY_UNSCANNED`` is assigned by migration to rows that predate the
scanner. It is never assigned to a new upload and never satisfies the
review gate, so historical rows are not silently certified as clean.

DocumentTypeOption.title: DocumentTypeOption
DocumentTypeOption.description:
A selectable document category, served by the API so the UI is not
the source of truth for the vocabulary.

DocumentVisibility.title: DocumentVisibility
DocumentVisibility.description:
Who may download a document.

STUDENT_VISIBLE: the owning student and authorized staff.
STAFF_ONLY: authorized staff only; never returned to students.

DormitoryAbsenceCancel.title: DormitoryAbsenceCancel
DormitoryAbsenceCancel.description:
Cancel an absence. The record stays, but stops counting.

Cancellation is deliberately not a correction to zero points: a zero-point
absence still says the student was absent, which is a different claim from
"this absence should not exist". The reason is mandatory and at least ten
characters, matching the correction contract.

DormitoryAbsenceCorrect.title: DormitoryAbsenceCorrect
DormitoryAbsenceCorrect.description:
Supersede an existing absence. The previous row is kept.

``reason`` is both the corrected record's reason and the justification for
the change, matching the academic correction contract: a correction always
states why it was made.

DormitoryAbsenceCreate.title: DormitoryAbsenceCreate
DormitoryAbsenceCreate.description:
Record a dormitory absence.

``housing_assignment_id`` is optional: when omitted the server resolves the
stay that covers the date, which is the only assignment an absence may
legitimately belong to.

DormitoryAssignmentRead.title: DormitoryAssignmentRead
DormitoryAssignmentRead.description: One institutional housing stay, as attendance reads it.

EpisodeAttendance.title: EpisodeAttendance
EpisodeAttendance.description: One episode as the student themselves sees it.

ExaminationCreate.title: ExaminationCreate
ExaminationCreate.description:
Create a scheduled examination.

``section_ids`` is required and non-empty: an examination that belongs to no
teaching section has nobody eligible to sit it, so it would be a schedule
with no meaning.

ExaminationDashboardCounts.title: ExaminationDashboardCounts
ExaminationDashboardCounts.description: Real figures computed in SQL. No sample data and no estimates.

ExaminationDetail.title: ExaminationDetail
ExaminationDetail.description: Staff view: the schedule plus who may sit it and what has been recorded.

ExaminationSectionRead.title: ExaminationSectionRead
ExaminationSectionRead.description: One teaching section sitting an examination.

ExaminationUpdate.title: ExaminationUpdate
ExaminationUpdate.description: Reschedule or correct an examination. Every field is optional.

FloorCreate.title: FloorCreate
FloorCreate.description: Create a floor within a building.

HousingAssignmentCreate.title: HousingAssignmentCreate
HousingAssignmentCreate.description: Schema for creating a housing assignment.

HousingAssignmentTransfer.title: HousingAssignmentTransfer
HousingAssignmentTransfer.description: Schema for transferring a student to a new bed.

HousingAssignmentUpdate.title: HousingAssignmentUpdate
HousingAssignmentUpdate.description: Schema for updating a housing assignment.

HousingImportReport.title: HousingImportReport
HousingImportReport.description: Result of validating or applying a housing allocation file.

HousingImportRow.title: HousingImportRow
HousingImportRow.description:
One spreadsheet row's outcome.

``status`` is a machine-readable token (VALID / CREATED / SKIPPED / ERROR)
so the UI localizes it like every other status. ``code`` is the reason a row
was skipped or rejected, translated client-side from ``errors.codes.*``.

ImmigrationChangeRequestResponse.title: ImmigrationChangeRequestResponse
ImmigrationChangeRequestResponse.description: Response for an immigration change request.

ImmigrationCohortResponse.title: ImmigrationCohortResponse
ImmigrationCohortResponse.description: Original-admission cohort context for one student.

ImmigrationCohortSummary.title: ImmigrationCohortSummary
ImmigrationCohortSummary.description: One named original-admission cohort in the live overview.

ImmigrationDocumentUploadResponse.title: ImmigrationDocumentUploadResponse
ImmigrationDocumentUploadResponse.description: Response after uploading an immigration document.

ImmigrationImportRecord.title: ImmigrationImportRecord
ImmigrationImportRecord.description:
One normalized import row; values use existing profile fields only.

``student_id`` is a *reference*, not necessarily a UUID: the student number
(``STU-123``) is what the registrar's sheet carries and what the student and
housing importers already use, so a batch can be built from one source file.
A UUID is still accepted for callers that hold the record id.

ImmigrationImportRequest.title: ImmigrationImportRequest
ImmigrationImportRequest.description: Normalized import batch, not an SCU spreadsheet format.

ImmigrationOverviewItem.title: ImmigrationOverviewItem
ImmigrationOverviewItem.description:
Student summary for immigration dashboard.

``original_admission_intake_*`` is the immigration cohort basis. The
``placement_intake_*`` fields are academic placement only and never affect
cohort attribution.

ImmigrationProfileResponse.title: ImmigrationProfileResponse
ImmigrationProfileResponse.description: Response for immigration profile (management/admin view with sensitive fields).

ImmigrationProfileStudentView.title: ImmigrationProfileStudentView
ImmigrationProfileStudentView.description: Limited immigration profile view for students (hides some sensitive identifiers).

change_reason.title: Change Reason
change_reason.description: Why the official record is being corrected; stored in history

ImmigrationProfileUpdate.title: ImmigrationProfileUpdate
ImmigrationProfileUpdate.description: Schema for updating immigration profile (management/admin only).

ImmigrationProfileVersionResponse.title: ImmigrationProfileVersionResponse
ImmigrationProfileVersionResponse.description: One immutable snapshot in a profile's history.

ImmigrationUntrustedCounts.title: ImmigrationUntrustedCounts
ImmigrationUntrustedCounts.description: Active students deliberately excluded from every named cohort.

IntakeOfferingPlan.title: IntakeOfferingPlan
IntakeOfferingPlan.description: One intake-specific programme offering to create if absent.

IntakePlanItem.title: IntakePlanItem
IntakePlanItem.description:
One academic intake to plan.

``status`` may not be ACTIVE for an intake whose start date is in the
future; a prepared intake is PLANNED until the institution opens it.

MigratedAdmissionCreate.title: MigratedAdmissionCreate
MigratedAdmissionCreate.description: Propose the original admission for an existing student.

MigratedAdmissionUpdate.title: MigratedAdmissionUpdate
MigratedAdmissionUpdate.description: Correct an unverified migrated candidate before both slots confirm.

MigrationQueueItem.title: MigrationQueueItem
MigrationQueueItem.description: One MIGRATED admission row in the staff verification queue.

NationalityDistributionResponse.title: NationalityDistributionResponse
NationalityDistributionResponse.description:
Aggregate nationality distribution for the immigration map.

Individual students are never returned. Values that are blank or that do
not match an ISO country name are reported separately so the map total
always reconciles with the cohort total.

NotificationType.title: NotificationType
NotificationType.description:
Machine-readable notification types.

The frontend maps these to localized text; the backend never sends
user-facing prose that the frontend has to parse.

OperationsReport.title: OperationsReport
OperationsReport.description: Cross-module operational snapshot for the dashboard.

OriginalAdmissionCorrection.title: OriginalAdmissionCorrection
OriginalAdmissionCorrection.description: ADMIN-only replacement of the original-admission pointer.

OriginalAdmissionCorrectionRead.title: OriginalAdmissionCorrectionRead
OriginalAdmissionCorrectionRead.description: Result of an audited pointer replacement.

PasswordChange.title: PasswordChange
PasswordChange.description: Self-service password change; requires the current password.

PasswordChangeResponse.title: PasswordChangeResponse
PasswordChangeResponse.description: Confirmation only. Never echoes a password or session token.

PasswordRecoveryAvailability.title: PasswordRecoveryAvailability
PasswordRecoveryAvailability.description:
Whether self-service recovery can actually work right now.

Reported so the login screen can hide the flow when no delivery channel is
configured, instead of offering a link that silently does nothing.

PasswordReset.title: PasswordReset
PasswordReset.description: Administrative password reset. Omit `new_password` to auto-generate.

PasswordResetCompletedResponse.title: PasswordResetCompletedResponse
PasswordResetCompletedResponse.description: Confirmation only. Never echoes the password or the token.

PasswordResetRequestResponse.title: PasswordResetRequestResponse
PasswordResetRequestResponse.description:
Acknowledgment of a reset request.

Always reports ``accepted`` so the endpoint cannot be used to discover
whether an address has an account.

``dev_token`` is populated only when the development delivery channel is
enabled, which is never the case in production.

PasswordResetSubmit.title: PasswordResetSubmit
PasswordResetSubmit.description: Complete a reset with a token from the delivery channel.

PlacementCreate.title: PlacementCreate
PlacementCreate.description: Assign or supersede a student's current academic placement.

PlacementRead.title: PlacementRead
PlacementRead.description: One placement, with admission and placement intakes kept separate.

ProgramOfferingUpdate.title: ProgramOfferingUpdate
ProgramOfferingUpdate.description: Editable offering metadata. The source identifier is immutable.

RequiredDocumentStatus.title: RequiredDocumentStatus
RequiredDocumentStatus.description:
One expected document category and whether the student has supplied it.

``MISSING`` is derived, not stored: a required category with no current
document is missing by definition.

ResolvedCalendarDayResponse.title: ResolvedCalendarDayResponse
ResolvedCalendarDayResponse.description: One date's classification, and where it came from.

ResultCorrect.title: ResultCorrect
ResultCorrect.description: Supersede a result. The previous score stays readable.

RoomBrief.title: RoomBrief
RoomBrief.description: Brief room representation for floor view.

RoomCreate.title: RoomCreate
RoomCreate.description:
Create a room.

`capacity` is the number of beds to create, expressed as an integer
because that is what an operator reasons about. The beds are created with
it, so capacity and beds can never disagree.

RoomUpdate.title: RoomUpdate
RoomUpdate.description:
Edit a room.

Raising `capacity` adds the missing beds; lowering it retires the
highest-numbered empty beds and is refused while they are occupied.

SectionProgramOfferingUpdate.title: SectionProgramOfferingUpdate
SectionProgramOfferingUpdate.description: The complete set of offerings a canonical section serves.

SessionInfo.title: SessionInfo
SessionInfo.description: One active login session, described without exposing its token.

StudentAcademicUpdate.title: StudentAcademicUpdate
StudentAcademicUpdate.description:
A retired self-service direct-placement selection.

All three fields remain in the contract only so a populated legacy body is
detected and refused. Programme changes use the dedicated Phase 4
admission-change endpoint instead.

StudentAccountResponse.title: StudentAccountResponse
StudentAccountResponse.description: A student's linked login account, without credential material.

StudentBrief.title: StudentBrief
StudentBrief.description: Brief student representation for list views.

StudentBulkResponse.title: StudentBulkResponse
StudentBulkResponse.description: Outcome of a bulk operation, reported per student.

StudentBulkStatusUpdate.title: StudentBulkStatusUpdate
StudentBulkStatusUpdate.description: Apply one status change to many students at once.

StudentCreate.title: StudentCreate
StudentCreate.description: Schema for creating a new student.

StudentDetail.title: StudentDetail
StudentDetail.description: Detailed student representation for profile views.

StudentDocumentSummary.title: StudentDocumentSummary
StudentDocumentSummary.description: Per-student document completeness, for the profile Documents tab.

StudentImportReport.title: StudentImportReport
StudentImportReport.description: Result of validating or applying an intake file.

StudentImportRow.title: StudentImportRow
StudentImportRow.description:
One spreadsheet row's outcome.

``status`` is a machine-readable token (VALID / CREATED / SKIPPED / ERROR)
rather than a sentence, so the UI localizes it like every other status.
``code`` is the reason a row was skipped or rejected; it is one of the
codes in ``errors.codes.*`` so the message is translated client-side.

A created row's account has no password: it is provisioned for activation
and cannot sign in until the student completes their single-use link.
``account_status`` says that in one token; no credential is ever present in
an import report.

major_id.title: Major Id
major_id.description: Retired: select an offering to create admission history.

program_id.title: Program Id
program_id.description: Retired: select an offering to create admission history.

StudentOnboard.title: StudentOnboard
StudentOnboard.description:
Onboard a student: create the record and its login account together.

This is the institutional onboarding path. The account and the student
record are created in one transaction, so a failure never leaves an
orphaned account or a student who cannot sign in.

StudentOnboardedResponse.title: StudentOnboardedResponse
StudentOnboardedResponse.description:
Result of onboarding a student.

``temporary_password`` is returned exactly once so an administrator can
hand it to the student. It is never stored in plaintext and cannot be
retrieved again — a reset issues a new one instead.

StudentPlacementStatus.title: StudentPlacementStatus
StudentPlacementStatus.description:
Whether a student may still choose their own academic placement.

Exposed so the UI can show either a selection form or a read-only value
with "contact the office to change this". ``can_select`` is always false;
the academic fields are derived from the effective admission and current
placement, not from Student columns.

StudentProgramOfferingUpdate.title: StudentProgramOfferingUpdate
StudentProgramOfferingUpdate.description:
Retired direct period-specific program assignment.

The contract remains only so a legacy caller receives the stable
``PLACEMENT_DIRECT_WRITE_RETIRED`` refusal. There is no direct-write
fallback: placement and programme changes use their workflows.

StudentResultRead.title: StudentResultRead
StudentResultRead.description: A student's own published result. Only ever built for published exams.

StudentSelfUpdate.title: StudentSelfUpdate
StudentSelfUpdate.description:
Fields a student may maintain on their own record.

This allowlist is the authorization boundary for self-service: anything
absent here (student number, status, official name, programme) cannot be
changed by a student, no matter what the request body contains.

StudentUpdate.title: StudentUpdate
StudentUpdate.description:
Schema for updating a student (partial update).

Management-only. Phase 8b retires all three direct-placement fields here;
they remain in the contract only so a legacy caller receives the stable
``PLACEMENT_DIRECT_WRITE_RETIRED`` refusal instead of a silent no-op. The
institutional identifier remains editable because a typo discovered after
onboarding has to be fixable without recreating the record.

SupportTicketCategory.title: SupportTicketCategory
SupportTicketCategory.description:
Category of a support ticket.

Kept as a controlled enum so categories cannot drift; additional
categories can be added in a future migration.

TeachableStaff.title: TeachableStaff
TeachableStaff.description:
A staff member who can be assigned to a class section.

Served so the assignment picker offers real people instead of asking a
clerk to paste a UUID. Intentionally minimal: name, staff number and the
account email, with no HR or personal data.

TimetableEntryCreate.title: TimetableEntryCreate
TimetableEntryCreate.description:
A new schedule slot.

The interval its two times form is *not* validated here. It is checked in
the service instead, so that an inverted interval produces the same stable
``TIMETABLE_INVALID_INTERVAL`` 409 whether it arrives on create or on a
partial update. A field validator on create alone would answer the two
halves of one rule differently — a JSON-array 422 the client can only
render as generic "check your input", and a coded error it can name.

TimetableEntryUpdate.title: TimetableEntryUpdate
TimetableEntryUpdate.description:
Editable attributes of a schedule slot.

``class_section_id`` is settable so a slot mistakenly booked against the
wrong section can be corrected instead of deleted and recreated, which
would break any reference to its id.

VacationRangeAdjust.title: VacationRangeAdjust
VacationRangeAdjust.description: Extend or shorten a range; omitted bounds keep their current value.

VacationRangeCreate.title: VacationRangeCreate
VacationRangeCreate.description: An institution-entered vacation, materialised date by date.

VacationRangeResponse.title: VacationRangeResponse
VacationRangeResponse.description: A range and the dates it currently owns.

VerificationActRead.title: VerificationActRead
VerificationActRead.description: One append-only confirmation or revocation act.

VerificationConfirm.title: VerificationConfirm
VerificationConfirm.description: One institutional confirmation of a migration candidate.

VerificationRevoke.title: VerificationRevoke
VerificationRevoke.description: Revoke one confirmed slot without erasing its act history.
